title: Fracture Reel
description: A woman in a worn blue jumpsuit sits on a tattered couch inside a crumbling, post-apocalyptic room, holding up a glowing painting that depicts a surreal green landscape. Cracks in the concrete wall emit an eerie green and orange glow, with exposed rebar, scattered film reels, and spotlights illuminating the decaying scene.
